title: The OyOy Experience: Mediterranean Cuisine overlooking Spinola Bay
text:
In the heart of St. Julian's, facing the spectacular coastline of Spinola Bay, OyOy Restaurant is born, a space dedicated to redefining Mediterranean cuisine in Malta. OyOy is not just a restaurant; it is a premium dining experience that awakens all the senses.

Set on a privileged terrace with panoramic sea views, OyOy invites diners to enjoy an exclusive setting, where sophisticated ambiance meets the freshness of the Mediterranean Sea.

Each dinner at OyOy is unique, marked by elegance and impeccable service that takes care of every detail.

A Mediterranean Gastronomic Journey

The essence of OyOy lies in its Mediterranean roots, offering dishes where oysters, fresh seafood and select fish are the undisputed protagonists. The menu is carefully designed by our executive chef, who fuses tradition and avant-garde to surprise in every bite. Fresh and local ingredients are masterfully combined to offer authentic flavors that respect the season and the environment.

Featured Dishes at OyOy

  • Selection of Oysters and Crudos: Taste the freshest oysters from the Mediterranean, complemented with delicate citrus touches and carefully chosen pairings.

  • Pasta and Risotto: Our artisanal risottos and pastas stand out for their smooth textures and intense flavors, reflecting the richness of Italian gastronomy adapted to Mediterranean tastes.

  • Main Dishes: Select meats and fresh fish of the day cooked to perfection, ensuring a complete gastronomic experience.

  • Gourmet Desserts: Exquisite sweet creations that crown your dinner on an unforgettable note.

A Wine Cellar of Excellence

At OyOy, wine pairing is fundamental. Our exclusive wine list features carefully selected labels from the world's best wine regions, ensuring the perfect complement to each dish.

Signature Cocktails by the Sea

The OyOy experience is complemented by a menu of original cocktails, created especially to accompany your afternoons and evenings by the sea. Our mixologists have developed innovative proposals that highlight Mediterranean ingredients in unique combinations.

In Search of Michelin Excellence

Our commitment to excellence is firm: we aspire to place OyOy among the most recognized and prestigious restaurants, with the dream of obtaining a Michelin star. Each visit is part of this journey towards culinary perfection.

We invite you to discover OyOy Restaurant, the must-visit gastronomic corner in Malta where luxury, gastronomic quality and exclusive ambiance come together to offer a memorable experience in front of the sea.

title: Fresh Seafood in Malta: Discover Our Exclusive Selection
text:
At OyOy Restaurant, we firmly believe that the quality of a dish starts from the careful selection of its ingredients. Located on the seafront on the beautiful coastline of Spinola Bay, our restaurant is renowned for offering an exclusive variety of fresh seafood, making it a must-visit destination for lovers of seafood flavours in Malta.

Freshness Directly from the Mediterranean

Our seafood is selected every morning directly from the Mediterranean, guaranteeing the utmost freshness and quality in every dish. We work closely with local fishermen who know the Maltese waters inside out, ensuring exceptional products that reflect the richness and biodiversity of the sea that surrounds us.

Exclusive Selection of Oysters and Crudos

The undisputed star of OyOy is our oyster, carefully selected to offer a unique experience to every diner. In our ‘Crudo’ section, you will find several varieties of Mediterranean oysters, accompanied by handmade condiments and personalised pairings that enhance their natural freshness.

Seafood Highlights

  • Gillardeau Oysters: served with gin & tonic gel and preserved lime dressing.

  • Local Prawn Carpaccio: prepared with ginger, lemongrass, soy dressing, fresh herbs and Xwejni sea salt.

  • Scallops: served with Granny Smith apple, coconut sauce, nori seaweed and samphire oil.

  • Barbequed Octopus: caramelised octopus with smoked potato sabayon and gremolata.

Exceptional Pairing: Wines and Cocktails

Our cellar offers select wines that enhance each dish, as well as signature cocktails specially designed to complement the freshness of our seafood.

A Commitment to Sustainable Gastronomy

At OyOy we are committed to sustainability, respecting the seasons and caring for the biodiversity of the Mediterranean Sea. This ethical approach guarantees an exceptional culinary experience, with the utmost respect for the product and the environment.

International Recognition

Inspired by restaurants recognised in prestigious rankings such as The World's 50 Best Restaurants, we aspire to become a benchmark of culinary excellence in Malta and beyond.

We invite you to book and enjoy a memorable dining experience at OyOy Restaurant.

Visit us and experience the magic of Spinola Bay by the sea.

title: WOMANIFEST 2025 - Malta's leading women's conference
text:
On the 13th of April 2025, OyOy Restaurant was honoured to host the inaugural luncheon of WOMANIFEST, Malta's leading women's conference. This event brought together many women leaders, entrepreneurs and creatives for a day dedicated to empowerment, inspiration and sisterhood.

An Unforgettable Meal by the Sea

On the eve of the conference, OyOy was transformed into the perfect setting. Our terrace, with panoramic views of Spinola Bay, provided an intimate and sophisticated setting where attendees enjoyed a high-end Mediterranean dining experience.

Beyond the Hashtag: An Evening of Connection and Sorority

The meal was not only a celebration of gastronomy, but also a space for women to meet and genuinely connect with each other. As one of the attendees expressed on social media.

| ‘Beyond the hashtag. Beyond the words. This event was a true testament to the power of the female community: authentic, supportive and deeply inspiring’.

Every conversation, smile and gesture of support contributed to an atmosphere full of energy, light and authenticity.

Event Gallery

We have compiled a selection of images that capture the essence of this magical evening. We invite you to relive these special moments through our gallery.

About WOMANIFEST

WOMANIFEST is an annual conference celebrating female leadership and creativity. With inspiring talks, workshops and networking opportunities, it has established itself as a benchmark in the field of female empowerment. For more information, visit their official website.

Led by our talented Maltese chef, our kitchen operates at the highest level, combining passion, technique, and creativity to deliver an unforgettable lunch or dining.

title: Mediterranean Gastronomy in Malta: From the Sea to the Table with Fresh Ingredients
text:
At OyOy Restaurant, we believe that an exceptional dining experience starts with fresh, local ingredients. Our ‘sea to table’ philosophy reflects our commitment to offer only the best that the Mediterranean and local Maltese producers have to offer.

Every day we carefully select our ingredients to ensure absolute freshness in every dish we serve. Recently, our chef had the opportunity to personally select a spectacular specimen of local fish, freshly caught and weighing 20 kg, demonstrating our real commitment to quality and freshness of produce.

The Importance of Freshness in our Cuisine

In our kitchen, this magnificent fish was prepared using culinary techniques that enhance its natural flavour, combined with creative recipes and complementary ingredients that bring out its essence. The result is an exceptional dish that defines the culinary essence of OyOy.

Restaurant Signature Dishes

We used this piece in particular for the Local Wild Fish Fillet: served with fennel, seafood, chorizo and a delicious bouillabaisse sauce.

Other fish and seafood you can find are:

White Fish Ceviche: prepared with ‘leche de tigre’, caramelised blood orange, salicornia and lavash cracker.

Meagre: served with cauliflower puree, leeks, lardo di colonnata and caviar beurre blanc.

Committed to Sustainable and Responsible Gastronomy

At OyOy we actively support local suppliers, ensuring sustainable and responsible ingredients. We share the message and values of international organisations such as Slow Food International, committed to good, clean and fair food. Our approach to sustainability not only ensures freshness and quality, but also contributes to preserving the marine resources of the Mediterranean.

Live the OyOy Experience

Discover the authenticity of Mediterranean gastronomy at OyOy, where every dish carries a story of dedication, quality and unsurpassed freshness.

Book your table now and enjoy the authentic taste of the Mediterranean.

title: St Julians Feast 2025: Celebrate by the Sea at OyOy Restaurant, Spinola Bay
text:
The traditional St Julians Feast is one of the most anticipated celebrations in Malta, bringing together locals and visitors in a festive atmosphere, full of culture, music and gastronomy. This year, OyOy Restaurant invites you to live this unique experience on our exclusive terrace in Spinola Bay, enjoying spectacular views and exceptional dishes.

Experience the Magic of the St Julians Festivity

Every year at the end of August, the streets of St Julians come alive with vibrant decorations, fireworks and cultural activities celebrating the town's patron saint. OyOy Restaurant offers a prime location to experience these special moments with a unique waterfront perspective.

A Special Gastronomic Experience for the Occasion

During the festivity, our restaurant prepares special menus that highlight the best flavours of the Mediterranean. Some recommended dishes for this celebration include:

Seafood Caramelle: Handmade pasta filled with fresh seafood with grilled squid and sea urchin sauce.

Meagre: Served with cauliflower puree, leeks, lardo di colonnata and beurre blanc with caviar.

Local Rabbit: An iconic Maltese dish that we offer in a variety of gourmet presentations, highlighting the local tradition.

Check our full menu here.

Book in advance

To fully enjoy the feast in the comfort and sophistication of OyOy Restaurant, we recommend booking your table in advance.

Book your table now and secure a prime spot to celebrate St Julians Feast 2025.

Why celebrate at OyOy?

OyOy Restaurant perfectly combines gastronomy, location and ambience. With unrivalled views of Spinola Bay, we offer an ideal atmosphere to appreciate the festivities while enjoying an unforgettable dining experience.

Optimise your visit

Make the most of your visit to OyOy Restaurant and explore more about Malta and its traditions. Discover the charm of the island during one of the most important cultural events of the year.

We look forward to welcoming you at OyOy Restaurant to celebrate together the magic of St Julians' Day.

title: Malta Restaurants St Julians: Discover the Restaurants with the Best Sea View
text:
